subject: FlatPosiitonMap::ReadCounts Optimization (#794)
reason: The change replaces memcpy-based little-endian count reads in FlatPositionMap::ReadCounts with an equivalent byte-wise ReadVarUint loop and deduplicates that helper out of PositionIterator into an anonymous namespace. On the little-endian platform the fuzzer runs on, the new decode computes bit-identical values from the same bytes (memcpy into a zero-initialized uint32_t of the low N bytes equals the shift-or loop), reads the same number of bytes, and the writer (WriteCounts) is unchanged; the structure is in-memory only, never serialized to RDB or the wire, so no cross-platform decode path ex
